ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; dominated by low-intensity black pixels with sharp, localized high-intensity white pixel distributions accounting for approximately 15% of the total fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black contiguous base layer; white linear vectors of varying lengths and orientations across both lobes; dense white circular pixel clusters concentrated at the terminal distal points of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped bifurcation; vertex angle approximately 55 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; predominantly smooth with localized pixel-level jaggedness near the median notch and distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature on both lobes, extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of circular white pixel groups localized on the outer 10% of the fluke's lateral span, primarily at the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density of high-contrast white linear pixel paths of varying lengths; varied orientations (diagonal and horizontal); distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive network of linear white scarring and circular barnacle clusters localized on the distal lobe tips.
